items.rationale: C1/C2/C5/C6: Cornulete is a concrete familiar pastry; normal is conservative at salience .55. The food meaning dominates standalone plural; new singular/case inputs keep cu gem against horn and figurative senses. DEX, RRI and current Romanian institutional recipe coverage independently support recognition and jam/nut filling (A1/A2/A4). All five direct incoming neighbors are recognizable: pastry, Christmas meal, biscuit cake, cozonac and walnut (C3). Actual Gem and Nuca now rank2 hot, Prăjitură4 and Cozonac6 hot, Faina9 hot and dessert14 warm (C4). This repairs the prior filling contradiction in the same wave. Sarmale8 remains over-warm via holiday context; butter/oil remain cold. These are real remaining weaknesses, but several defining filling/baking approaches now outrank or rival the noise. No alcohol/adult-dependent play, invented regional exclusivity or duplicate target (A3/A5/A6/A7). Promote this bound target while retaining the explicit noise and incompleteness limits.

C1/C2/C5/C6: Gogosi is an ordinary concrete fried-dough dessert with easy-band salience .72 and broad recognition. Lie, swelling and cocoon senses exist but need different context; new gogoașa prăjită explicitly selects the food. DEX and older/current Romanian radio/TV family recipes independently support the meaning and standard frying process (A1/A2/A4). Seven direct neighbors cover dessert, papanasi, clatite, langosi and street/fair food (C3). Repaired Ulei and Gem now each rank2 hot/nonwinning, matching Dessert2 and strong pastry peers; flour20, yeast27, milk44 and sugar66 are warm (C4). Oil is central to conventional frying, while jam is an ordinary filling/serving variant; neither is a universal claim about baked or plain variants (A3/A7). Butter/nut remain frozen and pan cold, which is disclosed. The defining frying plus ordinary filling approaches now work without changing identity or granting an ingredient win. No duplicate or editorial hold trigger (A5/A6). Promote.

C1/C2/C5/C6: Telemea is a concrete, unambiguous and broadly familiar brined cheese; salience .6784 supports easy. DEX, EU product specifications/production evidence and current Romanian public-institution coverage provide independent recognition/factual signals (A1/A2/A4). All ten direct neighbors are familiar dairy, cheese, polenta, pastry or serving concepts; the route does not depend on identifying a particular PDO region (C3/A7). Repaired Sare2 now agrees with Branza2, Mamaliga4, Placinte6 and milk14 (C4). Brining makes salt a defining association, with variable actual saltiness; the source remains a nonwinning salt guess. Four normative case/sort-plural inputs are exact. Unknown saramura and spuriously warm Drojdie13 remain significant gaps, but the strongest defining salt/cheese/use routes are coherent. No duplicate target, adult framing or generic regional premise (A3/A5/A6). Promote without claiming all production vocabulary or temperature feedback is correct.

C1/C2/C5/C6: Cartofi prajiti is a concrete universally nameable snack/garnish with one dominant compound sense; salience .6932 clears easy. Durable national-media preparation/use coverage and the ordinary noun/adjective food meaning support recognition and frying facts (A1/A2/A4). Its six direct neighbors are recognizable ingredient, cooking-device and serving contexts: potato, street food, mici, shaorma, air fryer and snitel (C3). The repaired Ulei2 now agrees with Cartof2, Snitel3, Mici4 and street-food5; salt29 is warm (C4). Conventional frying uses oil, while low/no-oil oven and air-fryer variants remain disclosed exceptions (A3/A7). Three singular/case forms now resolve exactly. Drojdie18 remains misleadingly warm, butter very cold and pan only lukewarm; this is incomplete feedback, but central potato/oil and common serving approaches now work. No duplicate, adult-dependent content or regional exclusivity (A5/A6). Promote.

C1/C2/C5/C6: Ardei umpluti is a familiar concrete dish with an unambiguous compound; normal is conservative at salience .5882. MDA explicitly defines peppers filled with meat/rice, and older/current RRI/TV independently document ordinary and vegetarian preparations (A1/A2/A4). All eight incoming neighbors support rice, vegetables, similar fillings, sauce or serving associations; weak zacusca/bors links are secondary (C3/A7). Repaired Ardei2 now joins Orez2, Legume3, Sarmale4, Rosie5 and Mamaliga7; meat21 is warm (C4). Pepper is constitutive but remains an ingredient, not a synonym or winning answer. Meat is common rather than universal. Drojdie11 remains falsely hot through an older broad projection and oil/butter are cold; these weaknesses stay visible in the decision. The defining pepper shell and filling routes now provide multiple much stronger approaches. No duplicate, adult framing or regional premise (A3/A5/A6). Promote this bound normal target.
